description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Hon. Gamini Vijith Vijayamuni Zoysa as the Minister of Irrigation & Water Resources Management, Hon. Faiszer Musthapa as the Minister of Provincial Councils & Local Govt. & Hon. Malik Samarawickrama as the Minister of Development Strategies & International Trade w.e.f. 09.09.2015. Appointed Hon. A. H. M. Fouzie as the State Minister of National Intergration & Reconciliation & 18 other State Ministers w.e.f. 09.09.2015. Appointed Hon. Sumedha G. Jayasena as the Deputy Minister of Sustainable Development & Wild Life & 20 other Deputy Ministers w.e.f. 09.09.2015. Appointed Hon. Anuradha Lanka Pradeep Jayarathne as the Deputy Minister of Mahaweli Development & Environment & Hon. Sarathi Dushmantha as the Deputy Minister of Justice w.e.f. 10.09.2015. Appointed Mr. Sumith Abeysinghe as Secretary to the Cabinet of Ministers w.e.f. 04.09.2015. Appointed Mr. V. Sivagnanasothy as the Secretary to the Ministry of Rehabilitation, Reconstruction & Hindu Religious Affairs & 44 other Secretaries to the Ministries w.e.f. 08.09.2015. Appointed Mr. R. M. W. Rathnayake & Mrs. Chandani Wijewardana as Secretaries to the Ministries w.e.f. 09.09.2015. Appointed Mr. Upali Marasinghe & 03 other Secretaries to the Ministries w.e.f. 11.09.2015.
